requirements: Reconcile the static recovery with all original A1 records and all planned paired diagnostic positions, including every negative or missing outcome. State the narrowest next physical or offline question and its required independent observation, controlled intervention and falsification condition. Retain current policy, original seventy-five-slot comparison and all fifty missing B/A2 slots; no physical native transition or protocol amendment is granted by this decision.

At the tighter current deadline preserve known-safe restored ordinary state, owned helper absence, immutable evidence and a clean pushed checkout.
